summary.all: All observed numeric values in the sample segment; missing remains null
summary.steady: Context-confirmed steady frames; unknown context excluded
summary.cost: Distributions in ms, memory in MiB; phases are wall intervals, not pure CPU busy time
summary.budgets: Numeric developer upper lines from budgets.json; no acceptance or stopping judgement

scenes: Latest AI session for each scene, previous session ID, metrics and per-metric value - previous plus signed change fraction; author sessions are shown separately
curves: Existing analyzer buckets; consumers select a level
inputStamp: File size/mtime, calc, dictionary and budgets; no build identity or condition freezing
